name: HTTP push
summary: Accept JSON, NDJSON or CSV records that devices POST to a local Ogun endpoint, with a bearer token, and log them as a durable stream.

auth.label: Bearer token per device or site

fields.name: push_token
fields.label: Push token
fields.help: One per line in a file that only its owner can access, named in ingest.json. Devices send it as Authorization: Bearer.

settings.name: bind
settings.label: Listen address
settings.help: Host and port the bridge listens on. A bind beyond loopback should sit behind a TLS proxy or a VPN.

egress.note: Inbound only: the bridge listens on the address you set and reaches nothing outside the machine.

operators.summary: Accept records pushed by HTTP POST and log them as a stream that feeds window partitions.

implementation.evidence: unit and loopback tests; not run against a real broker, network server or device

notes: The only listener the ogun-ingest bridge opens: POST /v1/streams/{workflow}/{node}/records. The reply is 202 after commit, or 503 with Retry-After while the log is full under block. It has no TLS of its own. A source without a token file does not start (O-10 section 2.4.2).
